name: Related Skills
headline: expo-deployment: Your App Deployment
short_description: The expo-deployment skill streamlines the deployment of Expo applications, automating the build and release process. With over 3,130 installs, it significantly reduces manual effort, allowing developers to focus on coding and innovation.
author: expo

sections.overview:
The expo-deployment skill is designed to simplify the deployment process for Expo applications. By automating the build and release stages, this skill allows developers to efficiently manage their deployment pipelines without the need for extensive manual intervention. This means that once your application is ready, you can deploy it with just a few commands, ensuring a smoother transition from development to production. One of the key benefits of using the expo-deployment skill is the significant time savings it offers. Developers can reduce the hours spent on repetitive deployment tasks, allowing them to focus on enhancing application features and improving user experience. This automation not only increases productivity but also minimizes the risk of human error during deployment, leading to more reliable releases. This skill is ideal for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are involved in the development and deployment of mobile applications using Expo. Whether you are a solo developer or part of a larger team, the expo-deployment skill can streamline your workflow and enhance collaboration. For example, teams can integrate this skill into their CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments every time a new feature is merged into the main branch. Implementation of the expo-deployment skill is straightforward, making it accessible even for those with limited experience in deployment automation. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows by enabling developers to leverage AI tools alongside their deployment processes. With the expo-deployment skill, you can ensure that your applications are deployed efficiently and effectively, allowing you to maintain a competitive edge in the fast-paced world of app development.
Automate the deployment of mobile applications built with Expo to various app stores.
Integrate deployment processes into CI/CD pipelines for seamless continuous delivery.
Reduce manual errors during the release process of mobile apps by automating build steps.
Streamline collaboration between development and operations teams with automated deployment workflows.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/expo/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Deploy the latest version of our Expo app [APP_NAME] to the [PLATFORM] store. Use the configuration file located at [CONFIG_FILE_PATH]. Ensure the build is optimized for [TARGET_DEVICE] and includes all necessary assets. Provide a summary of the deployment process and any potential issues to address.
```
Copy

```
The deployment of the Expo app 'FoodFinder' to the Google Play Store has been initiated. The build process is using the configuration file located at 'config/app.json'. The app is being optimized for Android devices and includes all necessary assets such as icons, splash screens, and images. The build process is currently at 65% completion. Once the build is complete, it will be automatically uploaded to the Google Play Store for review. Potential issues to address include ensuring all permissions are correctly set and that the app complies with Google's guidelines for publication.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
